# ITPF regular article — file upload instructions

This is a file designation guide, **not** evidence that the manuscript has been submitted or passed independent final-paper review.

## Files generated by GitHub Actions

- `submission-build/main.pdf` — compiled current manuscript PDF. The unnumbered ITPF-specific AI-use footnote must be visible on page 1, matching the end-of-paper Statements and Declarations.
- `submission-build/itpf-source.zip` — complete **editable** LaTeX source: `main.tex`, all input `sections/*.tex`, `references.bib`, `figures/Fig1.pdf`, `figures/Fig1.eps`, source plot files, and the plot generator. It must build cleanly.
- `submission-build/main.log` — local QA evidence only, **not** an ordinary submission upload unless editorial support asks for diagnostics.

Do **not** attach this README, internal working papers, test fixtures, prompts or draft-review logs as manuscript supplementary files.

## Current journal-required formatting

- Journal: **International Tax and Public Finance**. Select its **Regular Article** category (not Short Papers or Policy Watch unless the journal instructs otherwise).
- Paper title, author, affiliation/location, correspondence email, ORCID: from the title page / `submission/itpf/metadata.md`.
- Abstract: 150–250 words, no undefined SPNE; four to six keywords and appropriate JEL classification.
- Title-page AI footnote: required by ITPF's own journal-home policy, **even though Statements and Declarations already has an AI paragraph**. Declare matching uses in any portal AI fields.
- Figure: `Fig1.pdf` is embedded in LaTeX, `Fig1.eps` is the preferred publisher vector source, and the caption renders as **Fig. 1** without trailing punctuation. Upload the vector source separately if the portal requests it.
- Input all author contribution/CRediT and competing-interest declarations in the portal; manuscript declarations alone do not replace the interface.
- Subscription (non-open-access) publishing requested. The no-APC route does **not** establish that submission fees are zero. Stop before any mandatory payment under the author's existing zero-fee constraint.

## Hard pre-submit stops

Independent completed-PDF Stage-13 v3.1 review and second cold reading, author verification/approval of science and AI disclosure, latest Stage-14 exact source+PDF hashes and all-page QA, live portal fees and all required author attestations. Do not upload an older September 2026 PDF as a substitute. Do not claim SUBMITTED before real portal confirmation.

Official instructions: https://link.springer.com/journal/10797/submission-guidelines
ITPF-specific AI policy: https://link.springer.com/journal/10797
